answer.description: A concise Simplified Chinese explanation; use exactly an empty string for pure classification.

label.description: The classification label for classification tasks; otherwise null.

verdict.description: For every non-classification task choose supported, contradicted, or insufficient; otherwise null.

abstained.description: True only when evidence is insufficient and the answer explicitly abstains.

citations.description: Exact supplied Evidence identifiers without brackets or invented identifiers.

facts.description: Exactly the requested fact keys with concise canonical English values; use missing when evidence lacks a value.

route_selection_policy.eligibility: pass every critical gate for every case in the task class
